cohort: The study included 52 healthcare facilities in Liberia that confirmed operative capacity and performed surgical procedures requiring general, regional, or local anaesthesia in an operating theatre.
finding: Surgical human resources and infrastructure were strongly associated with operative volumes, and the availability of essential surgical procedures in Liberia was found to be extremely low.
cross-section timing: Data collection was performed between 20 September and 8 November 2018, using surgical volume data from September 2017 to August 2018.
